breakdown.reason: The generated specification still pairs each CCD direction with the opposite direction's PROCAR file. Specifically, `procar_0_minus_1_path` points to `ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR` (not `ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR`), and `procar_minus_1_0_path` points to `ccd_0_-1/1/PROCAR` (not `ccd_-1_0/1/PROCAR`). This is the same cross-pairing error from the incomplete prompt, which the ground truth corrects by matching each CCD direction with its own PROCAR file.
